sentences.sentence: Objects that are unmarked at the end of the mark phase are unreachable by the application (dead) because there's no path from the root set through any series of references to find them.

sentences.sentence: Russell said he couldn't get answers about his own treatment, and the man who once spent so much time offering care and advice was unreachable.
sentences.translation: 拉塞尔说他不能从自己的治疗中得出答案，并且这个曾经花费许多时间提供关心和建议的人是遥不可及的。

sentences.sentence: Hard working often counterbalances slowness at learning.
sentences.translation: 勤奋往往能弥补智力的迟钝。

sentences.sentence: Despite the difficulty of the task,and the slowness of the progress,the workers continued to plug away at it manfully.
sentences.translation: 尽管任务很艰巨，进展也缓慢，工人们仍顽强果断地继续干着。

sentences.sentence: This could not be otherwise ; and from the slowness of a vibration, or from the small number of vibrations in a day, Cavendish computed the real weight of the earth.
sentences.translation: 就是用这样的办法，通过观察这缓慢的振动和计算一天中的振动次数，卡文迪什计算出了地球的确切的重量。

text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 453 单元

untreated
音标：美 /,ʌn'tritɪd/
adj. 未经处理的, 未经治疗的
例句：untreated sewage
未经处理过的污水

folklore
音标：英 /'fəʊklɔː/  美 /'foklɔr/
n. 民间传说, 民俗学
例句：In Chinese folklore the bat is a symbol of good fortune.
在中国民间传说中，蝙蝠是好运的象征。

fumigate
音标：英 /'fjuːmɪgeɪt/  美 /'fjumɪɡet/
v. 熏制, 以烟熏消毒
例句：...fruit which has been treated with insecticide and fumigated.
...杀过虫、消过毒的水果。

unverified
音标：英 /ʌn'verɪfaɪd/  美 /ʌn'vɛrɪ,faɪd/
adj. 未经证实的,  未经核对的
例句：The general goal was to close all "unverified defects" before a specific date.
主要的目标是在一个具体日期前消除所有“未经核对的缺陷”。
例句：One potential hazard is the temptation to report unverified claims by scientists that would be rejected by a peer-reviewed journal.
一个潜在危险是你会被诱惑报道科学家未经证实的主张，而这些主张可能会被同行评议的杂志拒绝。

veil
音标：英 /veɪl/  美 /vel/
n. 面纱
v. 遮蔽, 掩饰
短语：under the veil of — 以…为借口
例句：She lifted her veil with both hands.
她用双手揭开面纱。
例句：a bridal veil
新娘的面纱

uncontested
音标：英 /ʌnkən'testɪd/  美 /,ʌnkən'tɛstɪd/
adj. 无争论的, 无异议的
例句：After an uncontested divorce, Peggy married Charlie.
和平离婚之后，佩姬嫁给了查利。

inspector
音标：英 /ɪn'spektə/  美 /ɪn'spɛktɚ/
n. 检查员, 巡视员
短语：inspector general — n. 监察长；检查长
短语：quality inspector — 质量检验员
短语：police inspector — 警察分局局；派出所所长
短语：ticket inspector — n. 查票员；收票员
短语：school inspector — n. 督学
例句：ticket inspectors
查票员
例句：a Health and Safety inspector
健康安全督察员
例句：Standards of discipline at the school were strongly criticized in the inspector’s report.
督察员在报告里狠狠地批评了这所学校的纪律水准。

nutritionist
音标：英 /njʊ'trɪʃ(ə)nɪst/  美 /nu'trɪʃənɪst/
n. 营养学家
例句：Nutritionists say only 33 percent of our calorie intake should be from fat.
营养学家说我们所摄入的卡路里中只应有33%来自脂肪。

dismal
音标：英 /'dɪzm(ə)l/  美 /'dɪzməl/
adj. 阴沉的, 凄凉的n沼泽
短语：dismal science — 忧郁的科学；悲观科学
例句：The future looks pretty dismal right now.
目前前景似乎相当暗淡。
例句：a dismal, grey afternoon
一个阴沉灰暗的下午

thicken
音标：英 /'θɪk(ə)n/  美 /'θɪkən/
v. (使)变厚, (使)变粗
例句：The fog was beginning to thicken.
雾气渐浓。
例句：Thicken the soup by adding potatoes.
加些马铃薯让汤变稠。

courageous
音标：英 /kə'reɪdʒəs/  美 /kə'redʒəs/
adj. 勇敢的
例句：He was wrong, and courageous enough to admit it.
他是错了，而且有勇气承认自己错了。
例句：a courageous decision
勇敢的决定

roe
音标：英 /rəʊ/  美 /ro/
n. 鱼卵,獐鹿
短语：fish roe — 鱼卵，鱼子
短语：roe deer — n. [动]狍（等于roe）
短语：richard roe — 某乙（对诉讼中不知名的当事人称呼）
例句：...cod's roe.
...鳕鱼子。

unrecognizable
音标：英 /,ʌnrekəg'naizəbl/  美 /,ʌnrɛkəɡ'naɪzəbl/
adj. 未被承认的, 无法识别的
例句：I hadn’t been to the city for 20 years and it was almost unrecognizable.
我已经 20 年没有到过这座城市，几乎认不出来了。

soup
音标：英 /suːp/  美 /sup/
n. 汤
短语：in the soup — adv. [口]在困境中
短语：chicken soup — 鸡汤；心灵鸡汤
短语：noodle soup — 面汤，清汤面条
短语：thick soup — 浓汤
短语：tomato soup — 番茄汤
短语：vegetable soup — 蔬菜汤
短语：mushroom soup — 蘑菇汤
短语：duck soup — n. 易事；好欺侮的人
短语：from soup to nuts — 从头到尾；一应俱全
短语：clear soup — 清汤
短语：onion soup — 洋葱汤；葱头汤
短语：soup stock — 老汤；肉汁清汤
短语：soup spoon — 汤匙
短语：soup of the day — 例汤
短语：corn soup — 玉米浓汤
短语：soup kitchen — 流动厨房；施粥场
短语：seaweed soup — 紫菜汤
短语：soup plate — 汤盘；汤盆
短语：pumpkin soup — 南瓜汤
短语：wonton soup — 馄饨汤
例句：homemade tomato soup
自制的番茄汤

directive
音标：英 /dɪ'rektɪv; daɪ-/  美 /daɪ'rɛktɪv/
n. 指示
adj. 指导的
短语：directive effect — [计]定向效应
例句：Thanks to a new directive, food labelling will be more specific.
由于官方的一项新指令，食品标签将会更明确具体。

september
音标：英 /sep'tembə/  美 /sɛp'tɛmbɚ/
n. 九月(略作Sep)
例句：Her son, Jerome, was born in September.
她的儿子杰罗姆出生于9月。
例句：We didn't make the original September 30 release date.
我们没有赶上原定9月30日的发行日。

unreachable
adj. 不能到达的,  不能得到的
例句：Objects that are unmarked at the end of the mark phase are unreachable by the application (dead) because there's no path from the root set through any series of references to find them.
标记阶段最后也没有标记的对象是应用程序不可获得的对象（死对象），因为不存在从根集经过任何引用序列找到这些对象的路径。
例句：Russell said he couldn't get answers about his own treatment, and the man who once spent so much time offering care and advice was unreachable.
拉塞尔说他不能从自己的治疗中得出答案，并且这个曾经花费许多时间提供关心和建议的人是遥不可及的。

stew
音标：英 /stjuː/  美 /stu, stju/
v. 炖, 焖
短语：in a stew — 烦恼；着急
例句：stewed apples
炖苹果

slowness
音标：美 /'slonɪs/
n. 缓慢, 迟钝
例句：Hard working often counterbalances slowness at learning.
勤奋往往能弥补智力的迟钝。
例句：Despite the difficulty of the task,and the slowness of the progress,the workers continued to plug away at it manfully.
尽管任务很艰巨，进展也缓慢，工人们仍顽强果断地继续干着。
例句：This could not be otherwise ; and from the slowness of a vibration, or from the small number of vibrations in a day, Cavendish computed the real weight of the earth.
就是用这样的办法，通过观察这缓慢的振动和计算一天中的振动次数，卡文迪什计算出了地球的确切的重量。

slavery
音标：英 /'sleɪv(ə)rɪ/  美 /'slevəri/
n. 奴隶身分, 奴隶制度
例句：attempts to abolish slavery
废除奴隶制的努力
